In detail

Porta Medaglia is a small, sparsely populated locality in the far south of Municipio IX, near the Divino Amore sanctuary, largely rural and residential in character. The only documented press mention found is an old article about neighbourhood neglect tied to stalled local construction works, which is dated and not indicative of current conditions. No recent safety concerns are documented for this area in local press, so it is rated green for both day and night.
